name: Shackleton Rim
notes: Chang'e-7 preferred area. Point from NASA Lunar Surface Data Book (ACD-50044 Rev A, May 2023), Table A2-2, R04/Site04. This point lies on the crater slope (772 m, about 800 m below the rim crest): terrain hides the Sun most of the time. Moving a few hundred metres changes the result completely.
